panels.title: Cost by model and provider
panels.description: Always group cost by model. llm_traces.model is not a substitute for model_provider: LiteLLM strips the provider prefix before the trace callback runs, so those rows cannot tell Vertex from AI Studio. Gemini's implicit-cache behaviour swings a single run's cost by a couple of percent — compare medians, never two individual runs. Covers 5 of 434 rows as of 2026-08-10 — model_name/model_provider only started recording 2026-08-07 onward; read this panel as provisional until more traffic accrues. All-time: the time picker does not move this panel. workflow_metrics carries no tz-aware column — see observability/README.md.

targets.rawSql: SELECT data->>'model_provider' AS provider, data->>'model_name' AS model, count(*) AS runs, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (data->>'total_cost')::numeric))::numeric, 4) AS median_cost_usd, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (data->>'workflow_duration_s')::numeric))::numeric, 1) AS median_duration_s FROM workflow_metrics WHERE data ? 'model_name' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY runs DESC

panels.title: Cost split: crewai against browser-use
panels.description: total_cost is these two summed. It does NOT include the learning path's LLM spend — see the learning-health dashboard. All-time: the time picker does not move this panel. workflow_metrics carries no tz-aware column — see observability/README.md.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS runs, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (data->>'crewai_cost')::numeric))::numeric, 4) AS median_crewai_usd, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (data->>'browser_use_cost')::numeric))::numeric, 4) AS median_browser_use_usd, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (data->>'total_cost')::numeric))::numeric, 4) AS median_total_usd FROM workflow_metrics

panels.title: Cost and duration per crew stage
panels.description: Covers 13 of 434 rows as of 2026-08-10 — this fills in as traffic accrues on this branch. The other 20 rows that carry the crew_stage_metrics key hold a JSON null rather than an object and are excluded so the panel doesn't error, not filtered as bad data. All-time: the time picker does not move this panel. workflow_metrics carries no tz-aware column — see observability/README.md.

targets.rawSql: SELECT stage.key AS stage, count(*) AS runs, round(avg((stage.value->>'cost')::numeric), 6) AS avg_cost_usd, round(avg((stage.value->>'duration_s')::numeric), 2) AS avg_duration_s, round(avg((stage.value->>'llm_calls')::numeric), 2) AS avg_llm_calls FROM workflow_metrics m, jsonb_each(m.data->'crew_stage_metrics') AS stage WHERE jsonb_typeof(m.data->'crew_stage_metrics') = 'object' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_cost_usd DESC

panels.title: Implicit cache hit rate
panels.description: Explains the run-to-run cost swing rather than leaving it as noise. A sample run cached 10,134 of 24,572 browser-use prompt tokens. All-time: the time picker does not move this panel. workflow_metrics carries no tz-aware column — see observability/README.md.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS runs, sum((data->>'browser_use_cached_tokens')::bigint) AS cached_tokens, sum((data->>'browser_use_prompt_tokens')::bigint) AS prompt_tokens, round(100.0 * sum((data->>'browser_use_cached_tokens')::bigint) / nullif(sum((data->>'browser_use_prompt_tokens')::bigint), 0), 1) AS cache_hit_pct FROM workflow_metrics WHERE data ? 'browser_use_cached_tokens'

panels.title: Dryrun gate outcomes
panels.description: 'unverified' means Docker or the executor was unavailable and the code was still delivered. It is an infrastructure signal, and is excluded from both sides of the pass ratio below. Covers 13 of 434 rows as of 2026-08-10; the other 20 rows that carry the dryrun_status key hold a JSON null rather than a string and are excluded so no blank-status row appears in the mix. All-time: the time picker does not move this panel. workflow_metrics carries no tz-aware column — see observability/README.md.

targets.rawSql: SELECT data->>'dryrun_status' AS status, count(*) AS runs, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_all FROM workflow_metrics WHERE jsonb_typeof(data->'dryrun_status') = 'string' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY runs DESC

panels.title: Gate pass rate, excluding unverified
panels.description: Covers 13 of 434 rows as of 2026-08-10. All 13 are 'passed' — zero failed, zero unverified in the corpus so far. Read the 100% as 'no failure has been recorded yet', not as a quality guarantee about the product. All-time: the time picker does not move this panel. workflow_metrics carries no tz-aware column — see observability/README.md.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE data->>'dryrun_status' = 'passed') / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS gate_pass_pct FROM workflow_metrics WHERE jsonb_typeof(data->'dryrun_status') = 'string' AND data->>'dryrun_status' <> 'unverified'

panels.title: Where the browser stage spends time
panels.description: poll_overhead_s is how long the backend kept polling after the agent finished. queue_s above zero means the browser service was at capacity. Covers 50 of 434 rows as of 2026-08-10; the other 169 rows that carry the phase_timings key hold a JSON null rather than an object and are excluded so runs matches what the averages are computed over. All-time: the time picker does not move this panel. workflow_metrics carries no tz-aware column — see observability/README.md.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS runs, round(avg((data->'phase_timings'->>'queue_s')::numeric), 2) AS avg_queue_s, round(avg((data->'phase_timings'->>'session_setup_s')::numeric), 2) AS avg_session_setup_s, round(avg((data->'phase_timings'->>'agent_run_s')::numeric), 2) AS avg_agent_run_s, round(avg((data->'phase_timings'->>'poll_wait_s')::numeric - (data->'phase_timings'->>'agent_run_s')::numeric), 2) AS avg_poll_overhead_s FROM workflow_metrics WHERE jsonb_typeof(data->'phase_timings') = 'object'

panels.title: Rate limiting and lost time
panels.description: The llm_429_count field is known to undercount against the raw log. Treat a non-zero value as a floor, not a total. Covers 49 of 434 rows as of 2026-08-10; the other 170 rows that carry the agent_diagnostics key hold a JSON null rather than an object and are excluded so runs matches what the sums are computed over. All-time: the time picker does not move this panel. workflow_metrics carries no tz-aware column — see observability/README.md.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS runs, sum((data->'agent_diagnostics'->>'llm_429_count')::int) AS total_429s, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (data->'agent_diagnostics'->>'llm_429_count')::int > 0) AS runs_with_a_429, round(sum((data->'agent_diagnostics'->>'retry_lost_s')::numeric), 1) AS total_retry_lost_s FROM workflow_metrics WHERE jsonb_typeof(data->'agent_diagnostics') = 'object'

panels.title: LLM calls and failures per hour
panels.description: Real LLM calls only — rows where llm_traces.model is set. The table holds 100,907 rows but only 2,829 are model calls; the rest are OpenTelemetry HTTP, agent, task and orchestration spans, and every ERROR row in the table belongs to those. Before 2026-08-12 this panel counted all of them and reported 1,298 failures, none of which were LLM failures. Measured 2026-08-12 with the filter in place: 2,829 calls, 0 failures, p50 2.5 s, p95 17.9 s. Spine is created_at, which is tz-aware, so this panel follows the time picker. History runs 2026-06-19 onward, which is why the dashboard defaults to a 1-year window rather than 6h.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'OK') AS failed_calls, count(*) AS llm_calls FROM llm_traces WHERE nullif(model, '') IS NOT NULL AND created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
